user.title: Connect to the Imou Open Platform
user.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret of your Imou Open Platform developer app. The README explains how to create one.

data_description.app_id: Shown under App Information in your Imou Open Platform Control Board.
data_description.app_secret: Shown next to the App ID. It is stored in Home Assistant and never logged.
data_description.region: The data centre of your Imou account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Imou
reauth_confirm.description: Imou rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current App Secret of your Imou Open Platform app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Imou cloud. Check your internet connection and the selected region.
error.invalid_auth: Imou rejected the App ID or App Secret.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This App ID is already configured.

init.title: Choose a robot
init.description: Choose the robot whose rooms you want to set up.

menu.title: Rooms of {robot}
menu.description: The robot does not report a map. Its rooms are read from the cleaning schedules in the Imou app and, on some models, from the cleaning order.

room_areas.title: Link the rooms of {robot} to areas
room_areas.description:
Choose an area for each room. The room takes the name of the area. On Home Assistant 2026.3 and newer the room is also linked to the area, so the Clean area action can use it. A room without an area keeps its current name, and on those versions its link to an area is removed.

The Imou app does not show room numbers. The Clean room buttons of this robot help to find out which number is which room: press one and see which room the robot cleans.

rooms.title: Room names of {robot}
rooms.description: The robot does not report a map. The rooms below come from the cleaning schedules in the Imou app and, on some models, from the cleaning order. Write one room per line as `id = name`. These names are used for room cleaning and in the schedules sensor.

data_description.room_names: One room per line, for example `3 = Blue room`. The id is the room number from the schedules.

error.invalid_room_names: Every line must look like `3 = Blue room`: a room number, an equals sign and a name.

abort.no_rooms: No rooms are known yet. The robot reveals its rooms in the cleaning schedules (and on some models in its cleaning order). Create a schedule in the Imou app that selects the rooms (you may switch it off afterwards), then try again.
abort.map_changed: The robot's active map changed while this form was open. Open Configure again.

model_not_fully_supported.title: {model} is not fully supported yet
model_not_fully_supported.description:
The robot model {model} differs from the models this integration was verified on. Missing core functions: {missing}. Values that are not recognised: {unknown}. Other functions may work, but the missing or unknown parts may not show or react correctly.

Please help to support this model: select Learn more to open a prefilled GitHub issue, and attach the diagnostics download of this integration (Settings > Devices & services > Imou Vacuum (Open Platform) > the three dots > Download diagnostics). Check the file before you attach it.

room_without_map.message: This room id has no map, which is not allowed on a robot with several maps. Link the rooms to areas again under Configure → Link rooms to areas.
